poetryFrame.leftVertical: WE COULD BUILD SOMETHING IN THIS SOFT LIGHT
poetryFrame.rightVertical: A BOND THAT RESISTS THE PASSAGE OF TIME
poetryFrame.bottomLine: THE RISK IS WORTH THE ENDLESS MOMENTUM
sonnetLines: The whisper of a promise made,
Against the glass where rain descends,
A fragile truth that will not fade,
We map our hearts in muted hues,
Through shadows cast by fading day,
Ignoring all the things we lose,
To keep this feeling far away.
A quiet plea beneath the glow,
For hands to hold and spirits near,
This love, a current strong and deep,
The promises we vow to keep.
